source: Met Office State of the UK Climate reports (2023, 2024); UKCP18 Headline Findings v4 (Aug 2022); Met Office City Pack probabilistic tables (Aug 2022)
note: Regional 2050s changes are 2040-2059 vs 1981-2000; ranges span RCP4.5 50th percentile to RCP8.5 90th percentile (summer rain uses the 10th percentile for the dry end). Growing season definition: 5+ consecutive days above 5C to 5+ below; last published on that basis for 2006-2015.
